definition: the act of coming down to the ground after a flight

definition: to stop being angry with someone who has done something wrong

translation: Я никогда не прощу ему, что он мне лгал.

definition: a statue or building made to remind people of a person or event

translation: Он любит чистить ботинки до блеска каждое воскресенье вечером.

definition: a machine that can do work by itself, often controlled by a computer

translation: На заводе машины красит робот.

definition: an amount paid regularly for insurance, or an extra payment

translation: Страховой взнос вырос после аварии.

definition: a person who knows a lot about one subject or skill
sentence: My doctor sent me to a heart {specialist}.
translation: Мой врач направил меня к кардиологу.

definition: to accept a new idea or change with enthusiasm
sentence: The whole team {embraced} the idea of working from home.
translation: Вся команда с радостью приняла идею работать из дома.

definition: the act of providing something, or a condition in a legal document
sentence: The {provision} of clean water is the first task after the flood.
translation: Обеспечение чистой водой — первая задача после наводнения.

definition: a person who works to bring about political or social change

translation: Активиста арестовали во время климатического протеста.

definition: to see or understand the difference between two things

translation: Я не могу различить близнецов, когда они одеты одинаково.

definition: not interesting; making you feel tired
sentence: The lecture was so {boring} that half the students fell asleep.
translation: Лекция была такой скучной, что половина студентов уснула.

definition: sure of yourself and your abilities, or certain that something will happen

translation: Она была уверена, что сдаст тест.

definition: the energy that flows through wires to give light, heat and power

translation: Буря отключила электричество на два дня.

definition: willing to help, or useful

translation: Персонал отеля был дружелюбным и готовым помочь.

definition: not wearing any clothes
sentence: The children ran {naked} into the sea.
translation: Дети голышом побежали в море.

definition: relating to long-term plans for achieving an important aim

translation: Порт имеет большое стратегическое значение для флота.

definition: the health, comfort and happiness of a person or group
sentence: The school really cares about the {welfare} of its students.
translation: Школа действительно заботится о благополучии учеников.

definition: someone or something that gives you new ideas or the wish to do something
sentence: Nature is the main {inspiration} for her paintings.
translation: Природа — главный источник вдохновения для её картин.

definition: to put something down carelessly, or to get rid of waste
sentence: Don't just {dump} your bag in the middle of the floor.
translation: Не бросай сумку посреди пола.

definition: to change something slightly
sentence: The tailor can {alter} the jacket to fit you.
translation: Портной может подогнать пиджак по тебе.

definition: a new business or activity that involves risk

translation: Их кофейный бизнес прогорел через полгода.

definition: freedom to live, act and speak as you wish
sentence: The statue is a symbol of {liberty}.
translation: Статуя — символ свободы.

definition: a list of food items and instructions for cooking a dish
sentence: This {recipe} for apple pie came from my grandmother.
translation: Этот рецепт яблочного пирога достался мне от бабушки.

definition: not afraid of danger or pain
sentence: It was {brave} of you to speak up at the meeting.
translation: Было смело с твоей стороны высказаться на собрании.

definition: to behave in a particular way because of something that has happened
sentence: How did your parents {react} to the news?
translation: Как твои родители отреагировали на новость?

definition: a person who owns or has something, or an object that holds something
sentence: Every ticket {holder} gets a free drink.
translation: Каждый обладатель билета получает бесплатный напиток.

definition: a knot with two loops, or a weapon for shooting arrows
sentence: She tied the ribbon in a neat {bow}.
translation: Она завязала ленту аккуратным бантом.

definition: a soft yellow food made from cream, spread on bread or used in cooking
sentence: Spread some {butter} on the toast while it is hot.
translation: Намажь тост маслом, пока он горячий.

definition: information put into a computer, or ideas and work given to a project
sentence: Your {input} at the meeting was very useful.
translation: Твой вклад на совещании был очень полезен.

definition: the words of a song
sentence: I love the melody, but the {lyric} makes no sense.
translation: Мне нравится мелодия, но текст песни бессмысленный.

definition: to refuse to consider an idea because it seems unimportant

translation: Не отметай план, пока не услышишь подробности.

definition: a door or gate where you go into a place
sentence: The main {entrance} to the museum is on the north side.
translation: Главный вход в музей с северной стороны.

definition: to shout very loudly, often in anger or excitement
sentence: There is no need to {yell}; I am standing right here.
translation: Не надо орать, я стою прямо здесь.

definition: the usual way or order in which you do things
sentence: Getting up at six is part of my daily {routine}.
translation: Подъём в шесть — часть моего ежедневного распорядка.

definition: to jump into water with your head and arms first, or to go under water
sentence: The boys {dive} off the rocks into the deep pool.
translation: Мальчики ныряют со скал в глубокую заводь.

definition: a party or special event for an important day or success
sentence: The whole village joined the {celebration} of the harvest.
translation: Вся деревня присоединилась к празднованию урожая.

definition: an office or organization that collects information or provides a service
sentence: The travel {bureau} booked our hotel and flights.
translation: Туристическое бюро забронировало нам отель и билеты.

definition: to bend your body in one direction, or to rest against something
sentence: Don't {lean} on the glass door; it might break.
translation: Не опирайся на стеклянную дверь, она может разбиться.

definition: to change something slightly to make it better or different
sentence: We {modified} the recipe to use less butter.
translation: Мы немного изменили рецепт, чтобы было меньше масла.

definition: the act of speaking or acting for someone, or a picture or model of something
sentence: Workers want better {representation} on the company board.
translation: Рабочие хотят лучшего представительства в совете компании.

definition: to shock or surprise someone so much that they cannot react
sentence: The news of her death managed to {stun} the whole town.
translation: Весть о её смерти потрясла весь город.

definition: relating to a political system in which the state owns everything
sentence: The country had a {communist} government for forty years.
translation: В стране сорок лет было коммунистическое правительство.

definition: to share information or feelings with someone by speaking, writing or signs
sentence: Deaf people {communicate} with their hands.
translation: Глухие люди общаются с помощью рук.

definition: a company that carries passengers by plane
sentence: The {airline} lost my suitcase on the way to Rome.
translation: Авиакомпания потеряла мой чемодан по пути в Рим.

definition: to limit how much someone can do, have or use
sentence: The doctor {restricted} my coffee to one cup a day.
translation: Врач ограничил меня одной чашкой кофе в день.

definition: to clean a floor with a brush, or to move quickly over an area
sentence: I will {sweep} the kitchen floor after dinner.
translation: Я подмету пол на кухне после ужина.

definition: to help something grow, or to care for a child that is not your own
sentence: Good teachers {foster} a love of reading in their pupils.
translation: Хорошие учителя воспитывают в учениках любовь к чтению.

definition: a service such as water, gas or electricity, or the quality of being useful
sentence: The rent includes every {utility} except the phone.
translation: Арендная плата включает все коммунальные услуги, кроме телефона.

definition: a place that protects you from bad weather or danger
sentence: We found {shelter} from the rain under a bridge.
translation: Мы нашли укрытие от дождя под мостом.

definition: to control and make decisions for a country or organization
sentence: The same party has governed the country for twenty years; who will {govern} next?
translation: Одна и та же партия управляет страной двадцать лет; кто будет править дальше?

definition: a sudden illness in the brain that stops a person moving or speaking
sentence: My grandfather had a {stroke} and lost the use of his left arm.
translation: У моего дедушки случился инсульт, и левая рука перестала действовать.

definition: a share or interest in a business, or a wooden post with a point
sentence: She owns a {stake} of twenty percent in the company.
translation: Ей принадлежит доля в двадцать процентов компании.

definition: a small piece of paper stuck on a letter to pay for sending it
sentence: Put a {stamp} on the envelope before you post it.
translation: Наклей марку на конверт, прежде чем отправлять.

definition: an area out of the sun, or a particular form of a color
sentence: We sat in the {shade} of a tall oak tree.
translation: Мы сидели в тени высокого дуба.

definition: a large hole in the ground, or a coal mine
sentence: The workers dug a deep {pit} for the foundations.
translation: Рабочие вырыли глубокую яму под фундамент.

definition: a water bird with short legs and a wide flat beak, or its meat
sentence: A {duck} led her six babies across the road.
translation: Утка вела шестерых утят через дорогу.

definition: after an event or time that has been mentioned
sentence: We went to the cinema and had dinner {afterwards}.
translation: Мы сходили в кино, а потом поужинали.

definition: used in "on ... of": for or in the interest of someone
sentence: I am writing on {behalf} of my mother, who is ill.
translation: Я пишу от имени своей матери, которая больна.

definition: the study of how money, goods and services are produced and used
sentence: She has a degree in {economics} from Oxford.
translation: У неё диплом по экономике Оксфорда.

definition: working well without wasting time, money or energy
sentence: The new heating system is much more {efficient} than the old one.
translation: Новая система отопления гораздо эффективнее старой.

definition: relating to electricity or using it
sentence: An {electrical} fault caused the fire in the kitchen.
translation: Причиной пожара на кухне стала неисправность электропроводки.

definition: in the most basic or important way; basically

translation: Два плана по сути одинаковы.

translation: Мой брат играет в хоккей за школьную команду.

definition: the activity of chasing and killing wild animals for food or sport

translation: Охота в национальном парке запрещена.

definition: worried and a little afraid about something that is going to happen

translation: Я всегда нервничаю перед экзаменом.

definition: recently; a short time ago
sentence: The {newly} married couple moved into a small flat.
translation: Молодожёны переехали в маленькую квартиру.

definition: normal and not special or different in any way

translation: Это был обычный день, пока не зазвонил телефон.

definition: not often, almost never
sentence: I {rarely} eat meat these days.
translation: В последнее время я редко ем мясо.

definition: to make a problem or pain less serious, or to move slowly and carefully
sentence: The new road should {ease} traffic in the city center.
translation: Новая дорога должна разгрузить движение в центре города.

definition: to say that something was caused or made by a particular person or thing

translation: Врачи связывают рост астмы с загрязнением воздуха.

definition: to explain something with examples or pictures, or to add pictures to a book

translation: Позвольте мне проиллюстрировать проблему простым примером.

definition: a new idea, method or product
sentence: The phone was a major {innovation} in its day.
translation: Телефон в своё время был крупной инновацией.

definition: the soft part inside the mouth used for tasting and speaking, or a language

translation: Горячий суп обжёг мне язык.

definition: to get something, like pleasure or an idea, from a source
sentence: I {derive} a lot of pleasure from cooking for friends.
translation: Мне очень приятно готовить для друзей.

definition: to tell someone that something is true so they stop worrying

translation: Он заверил меня, что посылка придёт к пятнице.

definition: a rule or law that limits what people can do

translation: В старом городе действует ограничение на парковку.

definition: a game with a bat and ball played by two teams of eleven
sentence: England and Australia have played {cricket} against each other for over a century.
translation: Англия и Австралия играют друг с другом в крикет больше века.

definition: the possibility that something will happen in the future
sentence: The {prospect} of another winter here scares me.
translation: Перспектива ещё одной зимы здесь меня пугает.

definition: the most powerful evil spirit in some religions, or a very bad person
sentence: In the painting, the {devil} has horns and a tail.
translation: На картине у дьявола рога и хвост.

definition: the place where an event such as a concert or match happens
sentence: The {venue} for the concert holds ten thousand people.
translation: Площадка для концерта вмещает десять тысяч человек.

sentence: Her {physician} told her to rest for a week.
translation: Её врач велел ей отдыхать неделю.

definition: a company or person that supplies a service such as internet
sentence: Our internet {provider} raised its prices again.
translation: Наш интернет-провайдер снова поднял цены.

definition: to judge how good, big or important something is
sentence: The doctor needs to {assess} the damage before we talk about surgery.
translation: Врачу нужно оценить повреждение, прежде чем говорить об операции.

definition: an animal like a large mouse with a long tail
sentence: A {rat} ran out from under the rubbish bags.
translation: Из-под мешков с мусором выбежала крыса.

definition: to eat, drink or use something, especially in large amounts
sentence: Big cars {consume} a lot of fuel.
translation: Большие машины потребляют много топлива.

translation: Переверни блин, когда края подрумянятся.

sentence: It was {fate} that brought them together on the same train.
translation: Это судьба свела их в одном поезде.

definition: to give all your attention to one thing
sentence: I cannot {concentrate} with the television on.
translation: Я не могу сосредоточиться при включённом телевизоре.

sentence: The dentist touched a {nerve} and I jumped.
translation: Стоматолог задел нерв, и я подпрыгнул.

definition: to develop slowly over time, or to change from a simpler form
sentence: Birds are believed to have evolved from dinosaurs; species {evolve} over millions of years.
translation: Считается, что птицы произошли от динозавров; виды эволюционируют миллионы лет.

definition: making you feel afraid
sentence: The old house looks {scary} at night.
translation: Старый дом ночью выглядит жутко.

definition: an important official who represents their country in a foreign country
sentence: The {ambassador} invited the writers to dinner at the embassy.
translation: Посол пригласил писателей на ужин в посольство.

definition: to ask for something in a strong, anxious way
sentence: The boy had to {beg} his parents for a new bike.
translation: Мальчику пришлось умолять родителей о новом велосипеде.

definition: permission or agreement to do something
sentence: You cannot use the photo without the owner's {consent}.
translation: Нельзя использовать фото без согласия владельца.

definition: to not do something you usually do, or to move with little jumps
sentence: I had to {skip} breakfast to catch the early train.
translation: Мне пришлось пропустить завтрак, чтобы успеть на ранний поезд.

definition: used in "for the ... of": for the good or purpose of someone

translation: Они остались вместе ради детей.

definition: a shape made by a line that curves round and crosses itself

translation: Сделай петлю из верёвки и протяни конец через неё.

definition: the state of being known and talked about by many people

translation: Юная певица обрела славу с самой первой песней.

definition: a common plant with thin green leaves that covers fields and gardens
sentence: The children lay on the {grass} and looked at the clouds.
translation: Дети лежали на траве и смотрели на облака.

definition: a person who takes photographs, especially as a job
sentence: The {photographer} asked the family to smile.
translation: Фотограф попросил семью улыбнуться.

definition: the period of time during which someone is alive
sentence: Travel has changed completely within my {lifetime}.
translation: Путешествия полностью изменились за мою жизнь.

definition: a feeling of cold, or a slight illness with shivering
sentence: There is a {chill} in the air this morning.
translation: Сегодня утром в воздухе прохлада.

definition: grown without artificial chemicals, or relating to living things
sentence: The shop sells {organic} vegetables from a local farm.
translation: Магазин продаёт органические овощи с местной фермы.

definition: a piece of music or writing, or the way something is made up of parts
sentence: The {composition} was written for piano and violin.
translation: Произведение написано для фортепиано и скрипки.

definition: to make goods in large numbers in a factory
sentence: The company will {manufacture} the new phone in Vietnam.
translation: Компания будет производить новый телефон во Вьетнаме.

definition: the number 30
sentence: About {thirty} people came to the meeting.
translation: На собрание пришло около тридцати человек.

definition: a person or company that buys and sells goods, often cars or art
sentence: We bought the car from a {dealer} on the edge of town.
translation: Мы купили машину у дилера на окраине города.

definition: a senior officer in the army
sentence: The {colonel} gave the order to move at dawn.
translation: Полковник отдал приказ выступать на рассвете.

definition: sudden and very noticeable, or exciting and full of emotion
sentence: There has been a {dramatic} fall in the price of oil.
translation: Произошло резкое падение цен на нефть.

definition: the slow development of living things over millions of years, or any gradual change
sentence: The {evolution} of the horse took fifty million years.
translation: Эволюция лошади заняла пятьдесят миллионов лет.

definition: recently; in the last few days or weeks
sentence: I have not seen her much {lately}.
translation: В последнее время я её почти не видел.

definition: far away from towns and other people
sentence: They live in a {remote} village in the mountains.
translation: Они живут в отдалённой деревне в горах.

definition: used to compare two things and show how they are different
sentence: He likes the city, {whereas} she prefers the country.
translation: Он любит город, а она предпочитает деревню.

definition: to have or own something
sentence: It is a crime to {possess} a gun without a license.
translation: Хранить оружие без лицензии — преступление.

definition: an area of activity or knowledge, or the address of a website
sentence: Medicine was once the {domain} of men only.
translation: Медицина когда-то была сферой только для мужчин.

definition: a room or building with equipment for scientific work
sentence: The samples were sent to the {laboratory} for testing.
translation: Образцы отправили в лабораторию на анализ.

definition: a house, especially a large or official one
sentence: The president's official {residence} is open to visitors in summer.
translation: Официальная резиденция президента открыта для посетителей летом.

definition: a sudden increase in business or wealth, or a loud deep sound
sentence: The oil {boom} made the small town rich.
translation: Нефтяной бум сделал маленький город богатым.

definition: a formal written agreement between countries
sentence: The two countries signed a peace {treaty} in Paris.
translation: Две страны подписали мирный договор в Париже.

definition: extra and not being used, or available
sentence: Do you have a {spare} key to the garage?
translation: У тебя есть запасной ключ от гаража?

definition: the amount by which one thing is bigger or better than another
sentence: We won by a {margin} of two points.
translation: Мы выиграли с разницей в два очка.

definition: the liquid that comes out of fruit when you press it
sentence: I drink a glass of orange {juice} every morning.
translation: Я каждое утро пью стакан апельсинового сока.

definition: the quality of working well without wasting time, money or energy
sentence: The new machines improved the {efficiency} of the factory.
translation: Новые станки повысили эффективность завода.

definition: a ceremony held when a dead person is buried or burned
sentence: Hundreds of people came to the {funeral} of the old teacher.
translation: Сотни людей пришли на похороны старого учителя.

definition: a particular type of solid, liquid or gas
sentence: The police found a white {substance} in the car.
translation: Полиция нашла в машине белое вещество.

definition: a short statement of the main points of something
sentence: Write a {summary} of the article in a hundred words.
translation: Напишите краткое изложение статьи в ста словах.

definition: a small piece of material covering a hole, or a small area of something
sentence: She sewed a {patch} over the hole in his jeans.
translation: Она пришила заплатку на дырку в его джинсах.

translation: Он преподаёт физику в средней школе.

definition: possibly; in a way that could happen

translation: Провод потенциально опасен для детей.

definition: not sensible or serious; a little stupid

translation: Было глупо выходить без зонта.

definition: happening after something else

translation: План предусматривает радикальные изменения в управлении школой.

definition: the state of continuing to live or exist, especially after danger
sentence: The sailors' {survival} depended on finding fresh water.
translation: Выживание моряков зависело от того, найдут ли они пресную воду.

definition: a film or program that gives facts about real people and events
sentence: We watched a {documentary} about life in the deep sea.
translation: Мы посмотрели документальный фильм о жизни в морских глубинах.

definition: an agreement to marry someone, or an arrangement to meet or do something
sentence: They announced their {engagement} at the family dinner.
translation: Они объявили о помолвке на семейном ужине.

definition: a group of ships, or all the vehicles owned by one company
sentence: The company has a {fleet} of fifty delivery vans.
translation: У компании парк из пятидесяти фургонов для доставки.

definition: the state of having a baby growing inside the body
sentence: She stopped smoking as soon as she knew about the {pregnancy}.
translation: Она бросила курить, как только узнала о беременности.

definition: a narrow way between places, or a short part of a book
sentence: A dark {passage} led from the kitchen to the garden.
translation: Тёмный проход вёл из кухни в сад.

definition: your name written by yourself in your own way
sentence: Please put your {signature} at the bottom of the form.
translation: Пожалуйста, поставьте подпись внизу формы.

definition: a small creature with eight legs that makes webs to catch insects
sentence: A {spider} spun a web across the window.
translation: Паук сплёл паутину поперёк окна.

definition: a group of lines in a poem or song, or poetry in general
sentence: The song has three verses, and she sang the first {verse} alone.
translation: В песне три куплета, и первый куплет она спела одна.

definition: a seed of some plants, eaten as a vegetable
sentence: Add a tin of white beans; each {bean} should be soft.
translation: Добавь банку белой фасоли, каждая фасолина должна быть мягкой.

definition: a government, especially a strict one that was not elected
sentence: The old {regime} fell after months of protests.
translation: Старый режим пал после месяцев протестов.

definition: a unit for measuring land, about four thousand square meters
sentence: The farm covers two hundred acres, with one {acre} of woodland.
translation: Ферма занимает двести акров, включая один акр леса.

definition: a book that tells you how to use or repair something
sentence: Read the {manual} before you install the heater.
translation: Прочитай инструкцию, прежде чем устанавливать обогреватель.

definition: a large building or area where sports and concerts take place
sentence: The {arena} holds twenty thousand people for concerts.
translation: Арена вмещает двадцать тысяч человек на концертах.

definition: to organize different people or things so that they work well together
sentence: One person should {coordinate} the volunteers on the day.
translation: Один человек должен координировать волонтёров в этот день.

definition: to provide a person or place with the things needed for a purpose
sentence: The school plans to {equip} every classroom with a computer.
translation: Школа планирует оснастить каждый класс компьютером.

definition: a long poem, book or film about heroes and great events
sentence: The film is a three-hour {epic} about the Roman Empire.
translation: Фильм — трёхчасовая эпопея о Римской империи.

definition: a department of a university, or the teachers in a school or college
sentence: She works in the {faculty} of law.
translation: Она работает на юридическом факультете.

definition: to travel by boat for pleasure, or to move at a steady speed
sentence: We will {cruise} along the coast for a week.
translation: Мы неделю будем плыть вдоль побережья.

definition: a person who writes poems
sentence: The {poet} read her new work to a small audience.
translation: Поэтесса прочитала новое произведение небольшой аудитории.

definition: a person who supports a leader or idea, or who follows someone online
sentence: Every {follower} of the singer got a message about the concert.
translation: Каждый подписчик певицы получил сообщение о концерте.

definition: the act of taking something away
sentence: The {removal} of the old bridge took three weeks.
translation: Снос старого моста занял три недели.

definition: the act of buying or getting something, especially a company
sentence: The {acquisition} of the small firm cost ten million dollars.
translation: Приобретение маленькой фирмы обошлось в десять миллионов долларов.

definition: a description of possible events, or the story of a film
sentence: In the worst {scenario}, the river will flood the town.
translation: В худшем сценарии река затопит город.

definition: a musical instrument that you hit with sticks or hands
sentence: He plays the {drum} in a rock band.
translation: Он играет на барабане в рок-группе.

definition: relating to thinking and understanding, or to people who think about ideas
sentence: Chess is an {intellectual} game, not a physical one.
translation: Шахматы — интеллектуальная игра, а не физическая.

definition: to hold someone tightly in your arms to show love
sentence: The girl ran to {hug} her father at the airport.
translation: Девочка побежала обнять отца в аэропорту.

definition: a person who works in someone else's house, cooking and cleaning
sentence: The old house had a cook and one other {servant}.
translation: В старом доме были повар и ещё один слуга.

definition: a sudden strong feeling of fear that stops you thinking clearly
sentence: There was {panic} in the cinema when the fire alarm rang.
translation: В кинотеатре началась паника, когда зазвонила пожарная сигнализация.

definition: an unfair opinion that makes you treat someone or something differently
sentence: He has a clear {bias} against anyone younger than him.
translation: У него явное предубеждение против всех, кто моложе его.

definition: to keep animals so that they produce young, or to produce young
sentence: They {breed} horses on a farm in Ireland.
translation: Они разводят лошадей на ферме в Ирландии.

definition: the grey powder left after something has burned
sentence: The fire left nothing but {ash} and black wood.
translation: От костра не осталось ничего, кроме пепла и чёрных головешек.

definition: to judge the value or quality of something carefully
sentence: We'll {evaluate} the results after the first month.
translation: Результаты мы оценим после первого месяца.

definition: sleeping
sentence: The baby fell {asleep} in the car.
translation: Ребёнок уснул в машине.

definition: working by itself without a person, or done without thinking
sentence: The {automatic} doors open when you walk towards them.
translation: Автоматические двери открываются, когда к ним подходишь.

definition: including everything or nearly everything
sentence: The report gives a {comprehensive} picture of the city's schools.
translation: Отчёт даёт полную картину городских школ.

definition: the act of destroying something, or the damage caused
sentence: The storm caused the {destruction} of hundreds of houses.
translation: Буря привела к разрушению сотен домов.

definition: very unusual, special or surprising
sentence: She has an {extraordinary} memory for names.
translation: У неё необыкновенная память на имена.

definition: the main office of a company or organization
sentence: The bank moved its {headquarters} from London to Dublin.
translation: Банк перевёл свою штаб-квартиру из Лондона в Дублин.

definition: the buildings, traditions and culture passed down from the past
sentence: The old town is part of the city's {heritage}.
translation: Старый город — часть наследия этого города.

definition: careful reasoning, or the science of reasoning
sentence: There is no {logic} in buying a car you cannot drive.
translation: Нет никакой логики в покупке машины, которую не можешь водить.

definition: the state of being alone and not watched or disturbed by others
sentence: Celebrities often complain about the lack of {privacy}.
translation: Знаменитости часто жалуются на отсутствие личного пространства.

definition: about, more or less, not exactly
sentence: The trip takes {roughly} two hours by car.
translation: Поездка занимает примерно два часа на машине.

definition: money paid regularly to a person who has stopped working because of age
sentence: Her {pension} is too small to pay the rent.
translation: Её пенсии не хватает на оплату жилья.

definition: the flat, sharp part of a knife or tool that cuts
sentence: The {blade} of the knife is rusty and dull.
translation: Лезвие ножа ржавое и тупое.

definition: the state of being away, or the fact that something does not exist
sentence: Her {absence} from the meeting was noticed by everyone.
translation: Её отсутствие на собрании заметили все.

definition: a set of clothes worn for a play or party, or typical of a place
sentence: He wore a pirate {costume} to the Halloween party.
translation: Он пришёл на Хэллоуин в костюме пирата.

definition: to join or connect a person or group with a larger organization
sentence: The local clubs decided to {affiliate} with the national league.
translation: Местные клубы решили присоединиться к национальной лиге.

definition: a plant or part of a plant eaten as food, such as a carrot
sentence: Eat at least one green {vegetable} every day.
translation: Ешь хотя бы один зелёный овощ каждый день.

definition: a person with very great intelligence or skill
sentence: Einstein was a {genius} who changed physics for ever.
translation: Эйнштейн был гением, навсегда изменившим физику.

definition: a measured amount of medicine taken at one time
sentence: Take one {dose} of the medicine every morning.
translation: Принимай одну дозу лекарства каждое утро.

definition: to start again after a pause
sentence: Talks will {resume} on Monday after the holiday.
translation: Переговоры возобновятся в понедельник после праздника.

definition: to run away from danger
sentence: Thousands of people had to {flee} the city before the army arrived.
translation: Тысячам людей пришлось бежать из города до прихода армии.

definition: to make someone suffer because they did something wrong
sentence: The school will {punish} any student who cheats.
translation: Школа накажет любого ученика, который списывает.

definition: to clean or dry something by rubbing it with a cloth
sentence: Please {wipe} the table before we eat.
translation: Пожалуйста, протри стол, прежде чем мы сядем есть.

definition: a clear and deep understanding of a complicated thing
sentence: Her book gave me a real {insight} into how banks work.
translation: Её книга дала мне настоящее понимание того, как работают банки.

definition: a piece of work given to a student or worker to do
sentence: The teacher gave us an {assignment} on the French Revolution.
translation: Учитель дал нам задание по Французской революции.

definition: a weapon that flies through the air and explodes when it hits its target
sentence: The {missile} hit the ship and set it on fire.
translation: Ракета попала в корабль и подожгла его.

definition: a person who makes or invents something new
sentence: The {creator} of the game became rich at twenty-five.
translation: Создатель игры разбогател в двадцать пять лет.

definition: a wild plant growing where it is not wanted
sentence: Pull every {weed} out of the flower bed before you plant the seeds.
translation: Вырви все сорняки с клумбы, прежде чем сажать семена.

definition: a feeling of worry and nervousness, or a bad relationship between people
sentence: There was a lot of {tension} in the room before the results.
translation: В комнате было очень напряжённо перед объявлением результатов.

definition: a very large group of stars held together in space
sentence: Our sun is one star among billions in the {galaxy}.
translation: Наше солнце — одна звезда из миллиардов в галактике.

definition: a small piece of advice or information given in an indirect way
sentence: Give me a {hint}: is the present bigger than a book?
translation: Подскажи немного: подарок больше книги?

definition: money or goods given to help a person or organization
sentence: The hospital received a {donation} of a million dollars.
translation: Больница получила пожертвование в миллион долларов.

definition: a person who continues to live after an accident, war or illness
sentence: The only {survivor} of the crash was a young girl.
translation: Единственной выжившей в катастрофе была маленькая девочка.

definition: relating to the voice or singing, or expressing opinions loudly
sentence: She was a {vocal} supporter of the new law.
translation: Она громко поддерживала новый закон.

definition: how much mass something has for its size, or how close things are
sentence: The {density} of ice is lower than that of water, so it floats.
translation: Плотность льда ниже, чем у воды, поэтому он плавает.

definition: to control an activity with rules
sentence: This device {regulates} the temperature in the room.
translation: Этот прибор регулирует температуру в комнате.

definition: the act of causing great pain to someone as punishment or to make them talk
sentence: The prisoners said they had suffered {torture} in the camp.
translation: Заключённые сказали, что в лагере их пытали.

definition: a public sale in which each thing goes to the person who offers most
sentence: The painting was sold at {auction} for two million.
translation: Картину продали на аукционе за два миллиона.

definition: a person who plays a musical instrument or writes music
sentence: The {musician} played the violin in the street for coins.
translation: Музыкант играл на скрипке на улице за монетки.

definition: a person between thirteen and nineteen years old
sentence: As a {teenager} she wanted to be a pilot.
translation: Подростком она хотела стать пилотом.

definition: something that exists separately from other things
sentence: The two companies now trade as a single {entity}.
translation: Две компании теперь работают как единое целое.

definition: likely to change often
sentence: The weather in the hills is {variable}, so bring a coat.
translation: Погода в холмах переменчива, так что возьми куртку.

definition: to lose or let fall, such as leaves, hair or tears
sentence: Trees {shed} their leaves in October.
translation: Деревья сбрасывают листья в октябре.

definition: to say that you are sorry for something you did
sentence: I must {apologize} for being late this morning.
translation: Я должен извиниться за опоздание сегодня утром.

definition: small in degree; not serious
sentence: There has been a {slight} rise in prices this month.
translation: В этом месяце цены немного выросли.

definition: a person who watches television or a film
sentence: Every {viewer} of the show can vote for the winner.
translation: Каждый зритель шоу может голосовать за победителя.

definition: to make someone extremely tired, or to use something up completely
sentence: Two hours of football will {exhaust} even the fittest player.
translation: Два часа футбола вымотают даже самого выносливого игрока.

definition: a small design used by a company as its symbol
sentence: The {logo} of the company is a blue bird.
translation: Логотип компании — синяя птица.

definition: the act of measuring something, or the size found by measuring
sentence: Take a {measurement} of the window before you buy curtains.
translation: Сними мерку с окна, прежде чем покупать шторы.

definition: three times as much, or made of three parts
sentence: The hotel charges a {triple} price during the festival.
translation: Во время фестиваля отель берёт тройную цену.

definition: the business done by banks
sentence: She works in {banking} in the city.
translation: Она работает в банковской сфере в городе.

definition: the study of substances and how they combine and change
sentence: We did an experiment with acids in {chemistry} class.
translation: На уроке химии мы ставили опыт с кислотами.

definition: the amount of something that people use or eat
sentence: Fuel {consumption} drops when you drive slowly.
translation: Расход топлива падает, когда едешь медленно.

definition: dishonest behavior by people in power, such as taking money for favors
sentence: The mayor was arrested for {corruption} after taking bribes.
translation: Мэра арестовали за коррупцию после получения взяток.

definition: a soft white material from a plant, used to make cloth and thread
sentence: The shirt is made of pure {cotton}.
translation: Рубашка сделана из чистого хлопка.

definition: extremely beautiful or pleasant
sentence: What a {gorgeous} day for a walk on the beach!
translation: Какой чудесный день для прогулки по пляжу!
